documents.text: Aurora launch is scheduled for October 12. The launch owner is Mira Chen. The release depends on the accessibility audit.
Lattice backups run at 02:00 each night. Backups are retained for 30 days. A restore is tested monthly.
Annual subscriptions can be refunded within 14 days of the initial purchase. Renewals have a separate 7-day refund window.
Embedding model changes require a new vector space. Equal dimensions do not establish compatibility. Keep the prior generation until preparation succeeds.
Provider API credentials are stored in the operating system keychain. They are never written into exported application settings.
El equipo de soporte atiende de lunes a viernes, de nueve a diecisiete horas. Los sábados no hay atención.
A transient HTTP 429 may be retried after Retry-After. A 401 authentication error should be surfaced without retrying.
